title: Add a single-repository release workflow
context: One command releases one repository: bump the package version, commit, tag, and publish artifacts with the tag equal to the published version.

spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: The tag equals the package version.
CI runs before the tag is pushed.
The workflow refuses when the working tree is dirty or `main` is behind.
Dry-run mode prints the planned changes.
Drift is detected and reported, not silently fixed.
